name: familyitguy
description: Claude Code plugins by Family IT Guy.

plugins.name: research-engine
plugins.description: Cited web research: Claude-led deep dives over the Perplexity Search API, plus quick Sonar lookups, background sub-agents, primary-source grounding, cascade follow-ups, and persistent thread files.

plugins.name: youtube-ingest
plugins.description: Ingest YouTube video transcripts, metadata, and search results via yt-dlp. No API key needed.

plugins.name: assess
plugins.description: Get sharper answers from AI by fixing the question, not the answer. /assess reads how you're directing the model and hands you a stronger way to ask, so it explores and pushes back instead of just running a mediocre prompt. Summon with /assess.

plugins.name: catch-me-up
plugins.description: Catch yourself back up on a work thread you've stepped away from. /catch-me-up reads your project's state docs and git history, reconciles them against the conversation, and hands back a briefing — what you're doing, what's done, what's left — plus the questions you haven't asked yet but should. Read-only. Summon with /catch-me-up.

plugins.name: afk
plugins.description: Set the autonomous working contract for when you step away. Tell Claude you're leaving — "AFK", "I'll be away", "see what you can do without me" — and it does the most valuable work it safely can unsupervised: deep, verified progress, no production changes, nothing sent, no metered spend, and a clean decision queue waiting when you're back.

plugins.name: rule-creator
plugins.description: Write the smallest instruction that actually changes how your AI behaves — a custom-instructions block, a CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md rule, or a skill — fitted to your harness and proven with a before/after demo. Use when you want your AI to start or stop doing something and reminders won't stick.

plugins.name: qa-webapp
plugins.description: Comprehensive 7-phase QA for any web app — functional, visual, performance, accessibility, security, cross-browser, failure-mode, and edge-case testing across a local → preview → prod pipeline. Separates analysis from remediation: reports findings as evidence-backed facts and lets you set scope and priority. No credentials of its own; needs playwright-cli. Summon with /qa-webapp.

plugins.name: strategic-planner
plugins.description: Turn a goal into a plan you'll act on and be measured against. /strategic-planner grounds the plan in your principles, gets the situation and the real objective straight, has you agree the single pivotal question before it proposes any answer, gives the answer with its reasoning and evidence, ties the plan to measurement, and stress-tests it before you call it done. Generalized from SCQuARE and Minto's Pyramid Principle. Summon with /strategic-planner.
